description: This file defines the Perl package 'Git::IndexInfo', implementing a class for interacting with Git index information, including methods to create, remove, and update index entries, along with handling pipes for commands.

classes.name: Git::IndexInfo
classes.description: A class representing interactions with Git index data, managing index entries via pipe communication with underlying Git commands.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes a new Git::IndexInfo object, setting up command pipes and configuration.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an index entry for a given path, writing the removal command to the pipe.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or adds an index entry with specified mode, hash, and path, writing to the pipe.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Destructor method that closes the command pipe upon object destruction.
